review_summary: 本批 3 条：e1（Child {Female}）为普通 NPC 称谓与性别控制标记组合，不构成专名，隔离；e2（user）在 ordinal 2 中仅是法球使用者的普通名词，非游戏术语，隔离；e3（Hardened）经 ordinal 6、7 证实为角色创建 Descriptor 名称，保留为 game_term/reference，纠正候选直译'硬化'为'坚韧'，并以 literal_context 限定其仅匹配 'the Hardened descriptor'，避免与普通形容词 hardened 冲突。已逐条核对 f1、f2。

before.corpus_evidence_note: Literal source match in definition/role cue records; may include one definition of the literal role following this term. Candidate evidence, not confirmed semantic equivalence; distinguish homonyms.

after.corpus_evidence_note: Literal source match in definition/role cue records; may include one definition of the literal role following this term. Candidate evidence, not confirmed semantic equivalence; distinguish homonyms.

applicability.reason: ordinal 6 中仅 'the Hardened descriptor' 这一紧邻字串指 Descriptor 名；单字记录 ordinal 1 为同名 Descriptor 标签，但为避免与普通形容词 hardened 全局误配，不设 text 全局匹配。

after.term_reason: ordinal 6 原文 'A set of bonuses granted by the Hardened descriptor.' 与 ordinal 7 的 Descriptor 说明共同表明 Hardened 是角色创建时赋予初始属性/技能修正的 Descriptor 名称，修饰对象为人物特质（经磨砺而强韧），而非材料'硬化'；该词同时是普通形容词，故仅作 reference 并限定语境。

changes.reason: 候选译名'硬化'按字面取材料义，与 Descriptor 所修饰的人物特质不符；据 ordinal 6、7 的 Descriptor 机制改为'坚韧'，并补齐 term_kind/enforcement/applicability 以限定使用范围。

evidence.text: A set of bonuses granted by the Hardened descriptor.
Your Descriptor provides additional modifiers to your starting Stats and Skills.\nOnce selected, your Descriptor cannot be changed.

changes.reason: 'Child {Female}' 是普通 NPC 称谓加 {Female} 性别控制标记的组合，不构成专名；{Female} 属运行时标记，应由保护规则处理，不收为 characters 术语。
ordinal 2 中 'the bounder absorbs the user' 的 user 指使用该球体的普通人，是普通施动者名词，无游戏特定含义，不按'身份'术语冻结。

evidence.text: Heavy and solid, this brown orb feels like a rock that has been worn smooth by a constant flow of water. On one side, there's an indentation that just fits a human hand. When activated, the bounder absorbs the user and teleports them to a nearby location within line of sight.
